clips.hook: The retention was terrible on the internal version of ChatGPT—it was like 5%.
clips.title: ChatGPT Launched With Only 5% Retention
clips.reason: Sam shares a masterclass startup lesson on why OpenAI launched ChatGPT despite terrible initial metrics, focusing on intense user love over broad adoption.

clips.hook: The thing that I realized I really missed is going to sit in a coffee shop on a Saturday afternoon...
clips.title: What Sam Altman Misses Most About Being Anonymous
clips.reason: A deeply vulnerable moment where Sam Altman reflects on the personal cost of fame and the loss of simple, everyday human freedoms.

clips.hook: I find this one of the most confusing things I have ever observed in my career.
clips.title: The Secret OpenAI Saw That Nobody Else Did
clips.reason: Sam explains how traditional AI researchers overlooked scaling laws because they believed neural networks couldn't create new knowledge, giving OpenAI a massive head start.

clips.hook: We decided we were going to bet the company on buying up a lot of compute.
clips.title: How OpenAI Bet Everything After GPT-4
clips.reason: A high-stakes insight into OpenAI's decision-making process right after finishing GPT-4, risking the entire company on massive compute acquisition.

clips.hook: When I talk to somebody in the US, they're slightly pessimistic about AI, but in India, they're very optimistic.
clips.title: Why India Loves AI More Than America
clips.reason: Sam Altman reveals the stark contrast in AI sentiment between the US and developing nations like India, highlighting India as one of ChatGPT's fastest-growing markets.
